- 当前问题: ## 背景
- 目标: Tighten explicit UI design flow evidence
- 背景: 来自 backlog R-226，Decision Brief 证据: Chat Decision Brief 2026-06-21: DocPath remains a general development workflow state machine, not a default design process manager; UI design flow is explicit opt-in only; optimize consistency and usability inside the opted-in flow.

- 不做什么: 不扩大到 backlog 未声明的产品/UI/架构范围
- 成本: 中等，按 plan 拆分后逐步验证

- 回滚方案: 回滚本任务提交，或将 backlog 条目退回 proposed
- 用户确认: 2026-06-21 user agreed to implement the read-only UI flow optimization analysis; explicit opt-in only remains required.
